rationale: Ceiling on the number of unreachable ('staged') src/lib modules — real, unit-tested code that nothing in the app imports, so no user ever sees it. RoamingEye accreted a large shelf of these; this gate stops the shelf from growing. Wiring a staged module into the UI lowers the count, and the ceiling should ratchet down with it. Like scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs, you may raise this number, but only deliberately, in the PR that justifies it.
